name: Create purchase order
description: Adds a purchase order to the system
whenToUse: Create a new purchase order for a vendor with dates and line items when recording a fresh PO (mutating).

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes

fields.name: vendor_id
fields.description: The hashed ID of the vendor

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: Due date for the purchase order

fields.name: private_notes
fields.description: Private notes for the purchase order

fields.name: public_notes
fields.description: Public notes for the purchase order

fields.name: line_items
fields.description: Array of line items for the purchase order
